title: Self-Improving Training & Thinking
abstract: arXiv:2601.21343v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models are classically trained in stages: pretraining on raw text followed by post-training for instruction following and reasoning. However, this separation creates a fundamental limitation: many desirable behaviors such as safety, factuality, overall generation quality, and reasoning ability are only added at a late stage, even though the patterns learned earlier strongly shape a model's capabilities. To tackle this issue, we introduce a new way to pretrain and mid-train models that incorporates these behaviors earlier. We utilize an existing strong, post-trained model to both rewrite data and to judge policy model rollouts, thus introducing thinking and reinforcement earlier in training. We further improve reasoning at all stages by introducing the concept of self-improving post-thinking: improving the model's reasoning and self-judging ability by reasoning after generation. translated_title: 自我改进的训练与思考
translated_abstract: 传统上，大型语言模型采用分阶段训练：先在原始文本上进行预训练，再进行后训练以学习指令遵循和推理能力。然而，这种分离造成了根本性的局限：许多理想的行为，如安全性、事实准确性、整体生成质量和推理能力，只在训练后期才被加入，尽管早期学习的模式在很大程度上塑造了模型的能力。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新的预训练和中期训练方法，将这些行为更早地融入训练过程。我们利用一个现有的强大的经过后训练的模型来重写数据并评判策略模型的输出（rollouts），从而在训练中更早地引入思考和强化学习。我们进一步通过引入“自我改进的后思考”（self-improving post-thinking）的概念，在所有训练阶段提升推理能力：即在生成之后进行推理，以提高模型的推理和自我评判能力。在实验中，我们证明了这些方法……
tldr: 该论文提出一种将安全性、事实性和推理等能力更早融入预训练与中期训练的新方法，通过利用现有强模型重写数据和评判模型输出，并引入“自我改进的后思考”机制，在训练全流程中提升模型的推理能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes incorporating desirable behaviors like safety, factuality, and reasoning earlier into pretraining and mid-training by using an existing strong post-trained model to rewrite data and judge policy rollouts, further enhancing reasoning at all training stages through a novel "self-improving post-thinking" mechanism.
